parts.text: {"title": "Build a Campfire", "steps": [{"instruction": "Clear a circle of bare earth and ring it with stones.", "companion": {"type": "zone", "shape": "circle", "size_m": 1.2, "stage": null}, "safety": false, "warning": null}, {"instruction": "Gather all three fuel grades before you strike a spark.", "companion": {"type": "checklist", "items": ["Dry tinder", "Thin kindling", "Thick fuel wood"], "stage": null}, "safety": false, "warning": null}, {"instruction": "Lay a loose nest of tinder in the centre of the pit.", "companion": {"type": "hologram_stage", "stage": 2}, "safety": false, "warning": null}, {"instruction": "Stack the kindling log-cabin style around the tinder core.", "companion": {"type": "hologram_stage", "stage": 3}, "safety": false, "warning": null}, {"instruction": "Light the tinder from the upwind side, then step back.", "companion": {"type": "compass", "label": "Check wind", "stage": null}, "safety": true, "warning": "Never light a fire in strong wind or under low branches."}, {"instruction": "Feed thicker wood once the flames hold steady.", "companion": {"type": "hologram_stage", "stage": 4}, "safety": false, "warning": null}], "next_suggestion": "gather firewood for the night"}
